note: Checkpoint E3 baseline: canonical MODEL CONSTRUCTION and CONTINUOUS solving are exercised directly against engine/source/plumline-engine.js through the canonical harness (E3 phase). E3 is structural and contractual: NO engine byte, mirror byte, tolerance, algorithm, pivot order, tie-breaking, normalisation, name, parameter, return, message, status or public output changed. The engine SHA stays 5d68ed17...; the mirror SHA stays 6190cb47...; branch-and-bound, integer/binary/mixed solving, final public status semantics and verification remain E4/E5. Current behaviours below are COMPATIBILITY CHARACTERISATIONS, not endorsements.

mirror.status: unchanged since E0; the legacy add-on twin; NOT reconciled in E3

exports.note: E3 list is a SEPARATE closed set, not a copy of E2. The harness serves both phases from one infrastructure; it never merges the two export sets. E2 stays exactly 24.

model_schema.note: The internal model consumed by optimise_/solveLinearProgram_. Field names are the REAL engine field names; do not rename.

constant.note: objective constant, folded into the objective value

integer.note: read by integerIndices_; EMPTY -> continuous path -> NO branch-and-bound

bounds.note: folded into constraints by applyBounds_; upper->x<=upper, lower>0->x>=lower

objective_direction.default: the model always sets maximize explicitly via senseFor_/pickObjective_ during construction
objective_direction.constant: model.constant is added to the objective value (e.g. +10 -> obj 13)
objective_direction.parsing_vs_construction: objective PARSING is E2 (linearize_); objective CONSTRUCTION (choosing the cell, sense) is E3 (pickObjective_/senseFor_); result PRESENTATION is E5/UI

constraints.strict_rejected: < and > as a relation are rejected by readConstraint_ with STRICT_INEQUALITY: (E2/E3 boundary)
constraints.rhs_normalisation: normalizeConstraint_: if rhs<0, negate coefficients, flip relation (<=<->>=, = stays), negate rhs

bounds.infinity_characterisation: an Infinity bound makes finiteModel_ return false -> optimise_ returns numerical_failure (CHARACTERISED current behaviour, not corrected)

domains_metadata.integer: integer:[i,...] -> would take the E4 path (NOT executed in E3 tests)
domains_metadata.binary: integer index + bounds {0,1} -> E4 (metadata only in E3)
domains_metadata.mixed: some integer indices -> E4 (metadata only in E3)
domains_metadata.rule: E3 reads/stores/classifies/propagates domain metadata but NEVER branches, tests integrality, or solves mixed-integer

continuous_dispatch.contract: optimise_ calls integerIndices_(model); if empty -> solveLinearProgram_ (E3). A fully-continuous model NEVER invokes solveIntegerProgram_ (E4).
continuous_dispatch.note: nodesExplored is undefined on the continuous path (only branch-and-bound populates it)

simplex.standard_form: solveLinearProgram_ maps constraints via normalizeConstraint_, adds slack for non-'=', artificials for non-'<=', total = n + extra + artificials
simplex.pivot: pivot_(...) — order, ratio test and tie-breaking are the engine's own; NOT changed
simplex.tolerances: EPSILON 1e-9, PIVOT_TOLERANCE 1e-7, MAX_ITERATIONS 20000 (unchanged; tests use existing tolerances, never a new one)

continuous_cases.desc: optimum at zero min x st x<=5
lower bound x>=2 (finite upper) min x

continuous_cases.note: finiteModel_ rejects Infinity; documented defect-adjacent behaviour, classified for a later algorithmic phase, NOT corrected in E3

errors.note: E3 records these; it does not redefine or translate them (translation is E5/UI)

legacy_reason.tests_strict.js: reaches readConstraint_ (E3 boundary) via run() but also solveModel_; strict rejection tested end-to-end — kept legacy
legacy_reason.tests_single_var.js: model construction + solve end-to-end; E3 contracts covered canonically
legacy_reason.tests_bounds.js: bounds folded into a full solve (E3) but assertions read final solve output (E5-adjacent) — kept legacy

suites.note: E3 migration is the NEW canonical E3 suites that exercise model construction + continuous simplex DIRECTLY through the harness. No legacy suite was migrated or split (migrated 0, split 0) because each reaches solveModel_ end-to-end and/or final-status assertions (E5) or branch-and-bound (E4).

readConstraint_divergence.description: readConstraint_ has an allowCachedFormulaFallback path that diverges by PLATFORM POLICY: on the web (newContext_ forces allowCachedFormulaFallback false) a formula whose stored value is 0 is NOT folded to its cached value; the add-on (mirror) allows it. For inputs that do NOT trigger the fallback, canonical == mirror exactly. For inputs that DO trigger it, the difference must match this approved contract exactly, never a false equality.
readConstraint_divergence.status: APPROVED, temporary; reconciled in E6, NOT modified in E3

parity.rule: inputs that do not trigger the approved divergences must be exactly equal; a third divergence must fail; the mirror is never modified to force parity

harness.mechanism: Node vm; test-only export epilogue; one infrastructure for both phases

allowlist.note: unchanged; the E3 harness/suites use a normal API, not raw reads; no negative is in the allowlist

provenance.model_and_simplex: characterised by running the canonical source through the harness (E3 phase) and via optimise_/detectModel_/solveModel_ probes on the pre-E3 tree; behaviour recorded as-is, no correction
provenance.parity: canonical harness/probe vs engine/engine.js at loadGrid_ (direct) and detectModel_/solveModel_ (observable)

do_not_regenerate: This fixture pins pre-E3 behaviour. checkCanonicalModelAndContinuousSolver verifies these contracts; the engine and mirror SHAs are pinned here and independently in engine-e0/e1/e2 fixtures. Do not rebuild from the running implementation; update only on a deliberate, reviewed baseline change. No absolute paths, no timestamps, no function bodies, no time-dependent data.
